sentence: To open this book at all needs 1,137,862 CNY of capital (IC account). IC is 137,862 CNY short of its first lot (capital 1,000,000, gap 13.79%). IM is 165,749 CNY short of its first lot (capital 1,000,000, gap 16.57%). IC: the desk's 4 lot(s) are withdrawn from the ticket and the executable line is 0; IM: the desk's 4 lot(s) are withdrawn from the ticket and the executable line is 0. The forward paper series that ran on 8 lot(s) across the accounts is kept and labelled FUNDED_BY_A_LARGER_CAPITAL: it is what a larger account would have done, not what this one can. It comes back the moment the capital does.

withdrawal.because: at today's capital the adopted 8% hard cap allows zero lots (r1779), so a ticket that carries the desk's four lots is an instruction the book's own risk standard forbids; leaving it there also keeps a forward paper series alive that no 1,000,000 CNY account could have held -- the series would read as performance when it is a counterfactual about a larger account
withdrawal.reversal: fund the account to the first rung and re-run: the same rule hands the ticket back one lot and this file prints it -- the withdrawal is conditional on capital, not a judgement about the sleeve
withdrawal.scope: the executable ticket only. The forward paper series is an append-only evidence line: it is re-labelled FUNDED_BY_A_LARGER_CAPITAL, never rewritten, truncated or deleted
